capability: Run scoped, tool-based code smell monitoring and report findings with explicit coverage.

install.description: Default missing (may install tools; needs network).

rules: changed_only replaces scope; architecture_only implies architecture; requirements requires architecture.

Status is the first match in order: error (exit 2, invalid request or failed requirement interpretation; no result is trustworthy), blocking_violations (architecture.enforced_violations > 0), incomplete (coverage.complete is false, or architecture requested and not covered), complete otherwise.
Only explicitly configured error rules count as enforced violations; cycles and high fan-in/out are review candidates.
fail_on_tool_error only changes exit_code; derive status from the rules, never from the exit code alone.
incomplete is partial evidence: absence of findings is not evidence of a clean scope; complete may still have findings.
out_dir and coverage are absent only on error before analysis.
With install missing the skill may install monitor tools into the user's Python environment; it never installs project dependencies or edits source files.
Compare two runs only when they used the same request; callers never edit the report directory.

changes.note: First contract: CLI flags as Request fields; status derived from exit code, coverage and enforced architecture violations.
Fold prose call-contract rules into rules; drop prose_contract. No behavior change.
